voice: female, warm, clear, calm, mid pitch, neutral American accent, friendly narrator
voice_ref_text: Every puzzle starts the same way: a pile of pieces and a little bit of patience.

scenes.name: v01_payoff
scenes.narration: Pick up piece number ten. It goes right here, in the top left corner. Now number eight, right beside it. One photo of your table, and your next piece is always clear.

scenes.name: v02_stuck
scenes.narration: You want the satisfaction of finishing a puzzle yourself. But sometimes you search the same pile again and again. Most helpers need the box image, or a scan of every piece. Puzzle A R starts from one photo of your table.

scenes.name: v03_title
scenes.narration: Puzzle A R. Snap a photo, find your next piece, and place it with guidance.

scenes.name: v04_snap
scenes.narration: Here is the real app, with a sample puzzle. Meta's Segment Anything model outlines every piece and gives it a number you can find on the table.

scenes.name: v05_meta
scenes.narration: Meta SAM three point one helps Puzzle A R see individual pieces. Our matching engine compares the shape and colors of every edge to find possible fits, and visual guidance helps you act on them.

scenes.name: v06_find
scenes.narration: Puzzle A R suggests where every piece belongs, using the real pieces from your photo. Tap a spot to see why a piece fits. You stay in control: confirm what works, and the next steps adjust around it.

scenes.name: v07_place
scenes.narration: Then it shows which piece to pick up, and where it goes, drawn right on your table. Mark the empty area once to see a ghost of the piece in its spot. A new photo checks the move, or you can confirm by hand.

scenes.name: v08_finish
scenes.narration: Step by step the picture comes together, and any move can be undone.

scenes.name: v09_outro
scenes.narration: Puzzle A R. Find your next piece, and keep the joy of puzzling.
